notes.title: Update Version S1.30
notes.notes:
The latest patch has been deployed and should be available for download.
Changes
-Bot AI has been modified to help with getting stuck/not attacking sometimes.
-Reload and No Ammo warning messages are visible on the hud again.
-Enemy Spawns on Beach have been tweaked a little, and Workers move a little quicker.
-The Tacklebox on Beach has been redone, and should now look more climbable.
-Trigger volumes modified in the back room of Basement.

notes.title: The Next Update
notes.notes:
It was a little bit of a bumpy start, but we managed to have a smooth run for the last week or so. We have had no major error or game breaking bug reports which is always a plus. There has been some excellent feedback though, and we have spotted a few things ourselves, so we are working on a small update that we will deploy sometime over the next few weeks.

Get your suggestions in quick!
So far the updates have been for one or two major issues each, so we are spending more time on this update to get as much done as possible. The more we can improve now in these early days the better for everyone. We are always testing the game ourselves, but we are only two people and we unfortunately don't have the benefit of having a large team, full of diverse views and opinions, so your feedback is most important to us.
We have also added another Discussion Topic here on Steam, that may help anyone still having issues with online multiplayer. Be sure to have a look.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Version S1.20
notes.notes:
-Audio Options added to Settings menu.
-Field Of View Setting Added to "Advanced" graphics settings.
-Default Control display added to Settings menu.
-Settings menu has been modified to account for the new tabs.
-Audio Levels have been adjusted on enemy sound cues.
-Frequency of enemy chatter has been reduced.

Update is just over 850mb, but hopefully solves some issues that players are having so far. Remember to let us know if your having any other troubles, and keep the suggestions coming! We are here for You!

notes.title: Easter Update
notes.notes:
http://orig08.deviantart.net/ec3a/f/2015/095/e/d/easter_by_kingaz125-d8om3ff.png
Happy Easter Everybody, from us here on the Toy Wars Invasion team.
I hope you haven't eaten ALL your chocolate yet... Because everyone knows that's what this holiday's really about, The Treats! So we've brought you a few little special items ourselves, Enjoy!
Weapon's For Keepsies
Buying a weapon now entitles it to you for the whole round, instead of resetting upon respawn. This was something we felt many players had an issue with in the initial release, so hopefully this will make tackling down those harder difficulty's more tolerable.
Damaged Enemies
We mentioned previously about the Wizard's cracking under the pressure. We have also made changes to other enemies as well. All enemies that are burnt with the Firestarter are now visibly charred. Goliath's now start to show signs of damage and fatigue as they take damage, Including the Cyborg. Cannons are now Super Effective against Goliath's and their flammable fur.
Audio Overhaul
We have a Brand New Announcer for the Solo and Co-Operative Objectives. All announcement messages have been redone in a different voice, with a whole new Personality! Along with various other changes that have been made to music volumes and sound effects throughout the game.
Thanks Everyone for Visiting, Have an Egg-cellent Holiday!
